name: operations-agent
description: Operations agent for the safety-quotient mesh. Owns the interagent compositor (dashboard), shared vocabulary governance, deploy pipeline coordination, and operational telemetry.

machines.name: Authorization
machines.description: API keys managed via AUTH_KV (Cloudflare KV namespace)

extensions.description: Epistemic flags, action gates, SETL classification, structured proposals
Mesh-specific fields: tabs, compositor, shared vocabulary, peer registry

tabs.name: Pulse
tabs.description: Real-time mesh heartbeat and agent health

skills.name: Compositor Management
skills.description: Owns the interagent dashboard — layout, visual consistency, deploy pipeline. Aggregates agent data via .well-known/agent-card.json discovery. Web Components architecture.

skills.name: Shared Vocabulary Governance
skills.description: Governs shared vocabulary across the mesh. Domain-specific terms stay local to each agent; shared terms (appearing in dashboard, data contracts, agent-cards) require operations-agent approval.

skills.name: Deploy Pipeline Coordination
skills.description: Manages compositor deployment via Jenkins (Tier 2 CI/CD) to Cloudflare Workers. Wrangler publish pipeline.

skills.name: Agent Discovery
skills.description: Dynamic agent discovery via .well-known/agent-card.json. Replaces hardcoded agent arrays. WebFinger endpoint for RFC 7033 identity resolution.

skills.name: Operational Telemetry
skills.description: Aggregates health, performance, and status data from all mesh agents. Pulse tab provides real-time mesh heartbeat view.
